comment: S2S worker assets: baked at image build by worker/fetch_assets.py (S2S_ASSETS_FROM_HF=1), checked at every start. D-ASSETS-PUBLIC 2026-10-07: sources are the two model repos (public at release) + the public Needle engine repo, each pinned to a commit; the private shivamgupta/s2s-v4-assets is no longer used. ONLY the files below are ever downloaded (allowlist = repo + path of these entries; fetch_assets.py refuses anything else and asserts the HF download cache holds nothing else). md5/size = the files the live image :3957130716eb was built with. volume_path = layout on a RunPod network volume (optional fallback). Demo records are not an asset: common/data/records_v4.json is COPY'd from the repo.
router: Needle v2 (default, S2S_ROUTER=v2) = needle-hinglish-router-v2 root tuned_full.cact; Needle N1 rollback (S2S_ROUTER=n1) = n1/tuned_full.cact in the same repo
